lines.en: Pages flip as I drift through the air.

lines.zh: 封皮蹭着石顶，我没发出声响。
lines.en: My cover grazes the cave roof without a sound.

lines.zh: 封皮一张一合，像在喘气。
lines.en: My cover opens and closes like breathing.
Paper edges slice the air, softly.

lines.zh: 我跟在火把后面，不敢太近。
lines.en: I trail behind the torch, not too near.
The underground draft pushes me along.

lines.zh: 我飘过水洼，倒影是一本书。
lines.en: I float over a puddle; my reflection is a book.

lines.zh: 书脊弯了一下，像在低头。
lines.en: My spine bends as if bowing.

lines.zh: 我绕开岩浆，怕那股热气。
lines.en: I skirt the lava; its heat frightens me.
Ink seeps from my cover.

lines.zh: 我无声地滑到石柱背面。
lines.en: I slide silently behind a stone pillar.
A page corner scouts ahead; then I follow.

lines.zh: 我悬在半空，一页页翻自己。
lines.en: I hang in the air, turning my own pages.

lines.zh: 洞里太静，我合上了封皮。
lines.en: The cave is too quiet; I close my cover.

lines.zh: 我把书页折出一道新痕。
lines.en: I crease a fresh fold into a page.

lines.zh: 我等火把烧完，等得很耐心。
lines.en: I wait for the torch to burn out, patiently.
Something crawls beneath my cover.

lines.zh: 我把字形重新排了一遍。
lines.en: I rearrange the letters inside me.

lines.zh: 纸页上有一行被划掉的咒语。
lines.en: One incantation on my page has been struck out.

lines.zh: 我在空中慢慢转，像在找字。
lines.en: I rotate slowly in the air, as if hunting a word.

lines.zh: 低语声从我书脊里出来。
lines.en: Whispers come out of my spine.

lines.zh: 我在等一个能站起来的影子。
lines.en: I am waiting for a shadow that can stand.
You have opened books, but never read me.
I square my cover to face you.
Don't touch my pages; you will regret it.

lines.zh: 你在火把边，我讨厌那个。
lines.en: You stand by the torch. I hate that.

lines.zh: 书页自己翻到有名字的那页。
lines.en: My pages turn themselves to the one with a name.
I recognize your handwriting.
You smell of ink.

lines.zh: 我停住，把你从头读到脚。
lines.en: I stop and read you from head to foot.

lines.zh: 你握火把的手在晃，光也在晃。
lines.en: Your torch hand shakes, and so does the light.

lines.zh: 洞顶那块黑的，不是石头。
lines.en: That dark patch on the roof is not stone.
Don't tear me! My pages will scatter.
My cover has a dent.
The writing has been smudged.
My pages scatter and I gather them back.
It hurts, but paper does not bleed.
My corner is bent.
You tore page three.
I gather my loose pages back in.

lines.zh: 这一下把我的顺序打乱了。
lines.en: That has scrambled my order.
I let out a thin hiss.
The smell of paper? That cannot be eaten.
Your book — let me see it.
I smell old paper and ash.
Lay it open; I don't bite.
What is on that page? Turn it over.

lines.zh: 我把书页张成一片，慢慢压下。
lines.en: I spread my pages wide and descend.
Lend me one line to copy. Just one.
That torch is too bright. Move it away.

lines.zh: 我伸出一页，等你放上去。
lines.en: I extend a page and wait for you to place it down.
My page edge is already curling.
You knocked my pages loose.
I flip backward through the air.

lines.zh: 纸边划到你，你自己撞的。
lines.en: A page edge cut you; you did the bumping.
Don't butt me; I will drop pages.

lines.zh: 我在墙上撞出一声闷响。
lines.en: I hit the wall with a muffled thud.
A corner of my cover is crushed.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，字都乱了。
lines.en: We collide, and the letters scatter.

lines.zh: 你袖口的体温，烤卷了我的页角。
lines.en: The warmth of your sleeve curled my page corners.
I swerve around you and float higher.

lines.zh: 碰撞声在洞里回荡很久。
lines.en: The impact echoes in the cave for a long time.
I leave you a blank page.

lines.zh: 两本书靠在一起，字会混。
lines.en: Two books side by side will mix their words.
I press my spine against your hand.

lines.zh: 你愿意在我的页上写吗？
lines.en: Will you write on my page?
I stop speaking and only listen to pages turning.

lines.zh: 封皮轻轻碰了一下你的额头。
lines.en: My cover brushes your forehead.
My letters are growing softer.

lines.zh: 我把最旧的一页撕下来给你。
lines.en: I tear out my oldest page for you.

lines.zh: 和你一起，书页自己会翻。
lines.en: With you here, my pages turn themselves.
Don't be afraid; I only want to be read to the end.
A new page. I take it in.
I tuck it inside my cover.
This line is good; I keep it.
Fallen paper belongs to me.
I flip it over to check the back.
The ink is still wet; don't touch.
I swallow a corner, and the words remain.
This sheet can mend my gap.
I carefully smooth it flat.

lines.zh: 我把它排在第七页后面。
lines.en: I slot it in after page seven.
Your name — I have found it.

lines.zh: 我把书页翻到召唤那一章。
lines.en: I turn to the summoning chapter.
This line is still missing your name.
The shadow on the cave roof moves.
I count to four, and someone comes.
You will fall before the torch does.

lines.zh: 我抬起封皮，露出里面的字。
lines.en: I lift my cover and reveal the writing inside.
Page turned. It is you.
My pages start turning by themselves.
The whisper becomes a call.

lines.zh: 我的骨头在封皮里响了。
lines.en: Bones rattle inside my cover.

lines.zh: 别回头，后面已经有东西了。
lines.en: Don't look back; something is already there.
You are in my table of contents.

lines.zh: 书页翻到你手背上那道口子。
lines.en: My pages turn to the cut on your hand.
Read this far and you will not move.
A skeleton already stands at your left.
A zombie is clawing out of the dirt.

lines.zh: 我把第三页撕下来吹过去。
lines.en: I tear out page three and blow it at you.

lines.zh: 你别靠火把，那里我进不去。
lines.en: Stay out of the torchlight; I cannot reach there.

lines.zh: 你再退一步，就踩到它们了。
lines.en: One more step back and you step on them.
I count the servants I have left.
Pages circle around you.

lines.zh: 我离你很近了，你听得见吗。
lines.en: I am very close. Can you hear me?
They feel no pain. You do.

lines.zh: 我把最后一页捏在手里。
lines.en: I pinch the last page in my grip.

lines.zh: 你身后的影子比两个还多。
lines.en: There are more than two shadows behind you.

lines.zh: 我从洞顶绕到你的死角。
lines.en: I drift along the roof into your blind spot.

lines.zh: 我听得出你数错了拍子。
lines.en: I can hear you lose the count.

lines.zh: 再近一点，我就能碰到你。
lines.en: One step closer and I can touch you.
I need no blade; I use paper.
They obey me, not you.
There is no exit in this cave, only pages.
I have written you into the next page.
A sheaf of pages slaps your face.
The page edge is sharper than you think.
I dive down from above.
My cover slams into your shoulder.
This page is for you.
Ink splashes into your eyes.
I strike, then float back up.
A page slices your sleeve open.
I tear one page loose, then another.
You shielded your face; then I cut your hand.
Don't grab me; I am all paper.
I bring my whole book down on you.
This blow carries a curse.
Get back; your blood is staining my pages.
I am not out of paper yet.
Paper falls everywhere. So do you.

lines.zh: 书页在黑暗里自己翻开。
lines.en: A book opens by itself in the dark.
I lower myself from the cave roof.
This page has no author.
The writing on the stone wall glows.
Paper lands first, then the cover.
Someone is walking under a torch.
My first task is to find a name.
Thick dust has settled on my cover.
Whispers seep from the cracks in the stone.
I shake off the old paper scraps.
The air in the cave has turned cold.
I can turn my pages again.

lines.zh: 热气和汗味，从下面飘上来。
lines.en: Heat and sweat drift up from below.

lines.zh: 我从书架的最底层醒来。
lines.en: I wake on the bottom shelf of a bookcase.
Fire! Keep that flame away from my paper!

lines.zh: 摔下去对我来说不算什么。
lines.en: A fall means little to me.
Water soaks my pages and smears every word.
The blast flips my cover open.
An arrow pins two of my pages.

lines.zh: 咒光一照，我的旧字开始褪。
lines.en: Spell-light hits and my old words fade.
Too long without words to read, I grow faint.
Lightning flashes and my page edges char.
My pages are pulled away and I sink.
